author: yassinyl
description: Decentralized microblogging platform for the fediverse.
tagline: A decentralized social platform for the fediverse

tips.before_install: Before installing, set MISSKEY_URL in the config service to the public URL that users will use to reach this instance. Set a strong, matching MISSKEY_DB_PASSWORD and POSTGRES_PASSWORD before the first start.
tips.after_install: Complete the initial setup in Misskey, then configure HTTPS with a reverse proxy before exposing the instance to the Internet. Configuration, uploads, PostgreSQL data, and Redis data are stored under /DATA/AppData/<AppID>.
